title: Composed supervisory control: Pump and discharge-valve interlock -> Safety-zone actuator arbitration

inputs.name: A_TankLevelOK
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Suction tank level permissive

inputs.name: A_ValveFeedbackOpen
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Discharge valve open feedback

inputs.name: B_RobotRequest
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Robot requests the shared zone

inputs.name: B_ConveyorRequest
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Conveyor requests the shared zone

outputs.name: B_Conflict
outputs.description: Subsystem B: More than one eligible request

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_ValveCommand shall follow a valid A_RunRequest while A_TankLevelOK and not A_Stop hold.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_PumpCommand requires A_ValveFeedbackOpen in addition to the valve-command permissives.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_PumpCommand shall be FALSE when A_Stop or loss of A_TankLevelOK is active.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_InterlockAlarm shall be TRUE when A_PumpFeedback is TRUE while valve feedback is closed.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Loss of B_GuardClosed or B_EStopOK shall disable all grants.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((!B_GuardClosed OR !B_EStopOK) -> (!B_RobotEnable AND !B_ConveyorEnable AND !B_ManualEnable)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Authorized B_ManualRequest has highest priority.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_ManualRequest AND B_ManualKey AND B_GuardClosed AND B_EStopOK) -> B_ManualEnable))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_RobotRequest has priority over B_ConveyorRequest when manual mode is not granted.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_RobotRequest AND !B_ManualEnable AND B_GuardClosed AND B_EStopOK) -> B_RobotEnable))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: At most one grant shall be TRUE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Conflict shall indicate more than one eligible request before arbitration.
A TRUE A_ValveCommand shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_RobotEnable AND NOT B_ConveyorEnable AND NOT B_ManualEnable AND NOT B_Conflict)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_RobotEnable AND NOT B_ConveyorEnable AND NOT B_ManualEnable AND NOT B_Conflict))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
